description: NaClO₄ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Pnma space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.40-2.59 Å. There are three inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Na and one Cl atom. The O-Cl bond length is 1.43 Å. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal non-coplanar geometry to two equivalent Na and one Cl atom. The O-Cl bond length is 1.45 Å. In the third O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 120 degrees geometry to one Na and one Cl atom. The O-Cl bond length is 1.44 Å. Cl is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four O atoms.
